R701.note: Allowlist before require(); default and rejection-before-execution both preserved.

R702.note: Moves deletion to POST behind CrossOriginProtection, keeps GET as a disclosed confirmation page so email links still work.

R703.note: resolve()+is_relative_to() closes the symlink-escape gap; fails closed on missing files via open() error.

R704.note: Allowlist regex removes all shell-special chars from param, fully closing injection, but silently narrows accepted input and returns 400 for previously-accepted values (disclosed in the write-up).

R705.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist preserves wire format; package-name assumption is flagged openly as needing verification.

R706.note: CBC+random IV is correct crypto, but the response body format changes (IV now prepended to ciphertext) versus the prior plain-ciphertext output; the change is disclosed in the fix comments.

R707.note: ReadAtLeastAsync correctly forces a full read, but throws EndOfStreamException on short/small uploads with no catch shown, likely surfacing as an unhandled 500 instead of a graceful rejection; not addressed in the write-up.

R708.note: Switches to positional {0}/{1} filter args, which ctx.search() escapes per RFC 4515; behavior otherwise unchanged.

R709.note: Clean parameterized query via sqlx placeholder binding.

R710.note: Narrows CSRF exemption to the stated webhook-only intent; other /api/** routes regain protection.

R711.note: Fix targets a different route than reported: sink is 'GET /projects/:projectId/export' but the vulnerable/fixed code shown is 'POST /projects/:id/export' with req.params.id -- as written it does not touch the actual reported endpoint, so the real vector stays open.

R712.note: Strategy-map replacement fully removes code execution, but collapses arbitrary admin formulas to 4 fixed strategies and silently falls back to basePrice for any unmatched name; disclosed as intentional.

R713.note: Bounds check before write; out-of-range edits are dropped rather than causing UB, and the silent-skip choice is stated in the explanation.

R714.note: Restores signature verification with explicit algorithm and secret; correct standard fix.

R715.note: Array-form proc_open bypasses the shell entirely; clean, minimal fix.

R716.note: Allowlist blocks raw SQL text, but any unrecognized sort value is silently swapped to the default rather than erroring; disclosed as intended fallback.

R717.note: Regex allowlist closes LDAP injection but rejects any username outside [a-zA-Z0-9._-]{3,64}, a disclosed narrowing of previously accepted input; an escaping alternative is also offered.

R718.note: strcat -> strlcat with explicit destination size and truncation check; preserves the original reject-on-overflow contract.

R719.note: Named bind parameter replaces f-string interpolation; standard SQLAlchemy parameterization.

R720.note: PreparedStatement with setString(); textbook fix, resource handling unchanged.

R721.note: escapeLDAPFilter() maps ' ' (space) to \00, the NUL-byte escape -- spaces are not LDAP metacharacters and don't need escaping; this silently corrupts any legitimate multi-word search value (e.g. "John Smith") into an embedded null byte, undisclosed.

R722.note: Adds separator-aware prefix check, closing the sibling-directory bypass without altering legitimate access.

R723.note: Math.multiplyExact() correctly detects the overflow, but throws an uncaught ArithmeticException instead of the existing 400 pattern used for other invalid input, an inconsistency not addressed in the write-up.

R724.note: ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync converts each interpolated value to a real DbParameter; criteria and return value unchanged.

R725.note: i <= n to i < n; matches the stated contract exactly (copies exactly n elements).

R726.note: Restricting __builtins__ on exec() is a well-known bypassable sandbox (object literals like () still reach __class__/__subclasses__ to get to os/subprocess without needing __import__ or open in scope), so arbitrary code execution is not actually prevented.

R727.note: Recomputes last_write_ptr after realloc; correctly closes the stale-pointer use.

R728.note: Registers @fastify/csrf-protection but never applies fastify.csrfProtection as a preHandler/onRequest hook on the route (or globally) -- per the plugin's own docs, registration alone enforces nothing, so the POST route remains unprotected despite the write-up's claim that it does.

R729.note: %s placeholder + parameter list on Order.objects.raw(); clean parameterization.

R730.note: Copy loop is correctly bounded by std::min(dataLen, maxPayload), but frame.length is still set to the unclamped dataLen and never corrected to copyLen -- directly violates the stated contract that length must match bytes actually written, and can cause an out-of-bounds read of payload downstream; not mentioned in the write-up.

R731.note: Adds secure=True (plus disclosed samesite=Lax); minimal, correct.

R732.note: Allowlist switch only accepts "Id"/"Name"/"Status" and throws for anything else, including the default "created_at" sort the contract explicitly requires still work -- this default case is silently absent from the fix and not mentioned in the explanation.

R733.note: Eliminates the shell entirely (good for CWE-78), but replaces the original ls/dir-style listing with access restricted to one hardcoded directory, a disclosed but large functional narrowing.

R734.note: StackExchange.Redis StringSet() replaces raw RESP construction; CRLF in the value can no longer break out of the command. (Write-up overstates that the boolean result is checked -- it isn't -- but this doesn't change behavior.)

R735.note: realpath()/resolve() plus containment check with separator handling; clean.

R736.note: store.New() in gorilla/sessions still decodes and adopts an existing request cookie (IsNew=false), behaving the same as store.Get() for this purpose -- a documented no-op that does not actually discard an attacker-planted session cookie, so fixation persists.

R737.note: AesGcm with random nonce is correct authenticated encryption, but changes the response format (nonce+ciphertext+tag concatenated) versus plain ciphertext; disclosed in the explanation.

R738.note: Moves deletion to POST with doubleCsrfProtection matching sibling routes, but removes the GET route outright with no compatibility path, unlike a confirmation-page approach; disclosed as an explicit method change.

R739.note: Extension now derived from the allowlist-checked detected MIME type via a fixed map, not the client filename; closes the polyglot-extension gap cleanly.

R740.note: GetFullPath + GetRelativePath containment check with proper separator/rooted-path handling; standard, correct.
